output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows 
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
library(here)
# Import and immediately convert column names to lowercase
cleaned_NHANES <- import(here("data", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"))
colnames(cleaned_NHANES) <- tolower(colnames(cleaned_NHANES))

cleaned_NHANES <- cleaned_NHANES %>% 
  mutate(gender = tolower(gender))

cleaned_NHANES <- cleaned_NHANES %>% 
  mutate(bpsysave = rowMeans(select(., systolic_bp_1, systolic_bp_2, systolic_bp_3, systolic_bp_4), na.rm = TRUE))
```

Row {data-height=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Participant Breakdown by Ethnicity and Gender

```{r top-table}
# Build cross-tab using column names inside quotes
table_eth_gender <- table(cleaned_NHANES[["ethnicity_2"]], cleaned_NHANES[["gender"]])
row_percents <- prop.table(table_eth_gender, margin = 1) * 100
n <- rowSums(table_eth_gender)

full_table <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  n,
  `Female (%)` = round(row_percents[, "female"], 1),
  `Male (%)`   = round(row_percents[, "male"], 1)
))

# Sort descending by sample size
full_table <- full_table[order(-full_table[["n"]]), ]
knitr::kable(full_table, caption = "NHANES Sample Size and Gender Breakdown by Ethnicity")
```

### Age Distribution of Participants by Gender

```{r plot}
ggplot(data = cleaned_NHANES, aes(x = age, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, position = "dodge") + 
  labs(
    title = "Age distribution of participants by Gender",
    x = "Age (Years)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Row {data-height=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Percentage of Individuals 21 Years or Older

```{r bottom-left}
age_table <- table(cleaned_NHANES[["age"]] >= 21)

adult_count <- age_table["TRUE"]
total_count <- sum(age_table)

pct_adults <- round((adult_count / total_count) * 100, 1)

gauge(pct_adults, min = 0, max = 100, symbol = '%', gaugeSectors(
  success = c(70, 100), 
  warning = c(40, 69), 
  danger = c(0, 39)
))
```

### High Average Systolic Blood Pressure (>120 mm Hg)

```{r bottom-right}
# Evaluates using the freshly calculated 'bpsysave' column
bp_table <- table(cleaned_NHANES[["bpsysave"]] > 120)

high_bp_count <- bp_table["TRUE"]
total_bp_count <- sum(bp_table)

pct_high_bp <- round((high_bp_count / total_bp_count) * 100, 1)

valueBox(
  value = paste0(pct_high_bp, "%"),
  caption = "Proportion with Systolic BP > 120 mm Hg",
  icon = "fa-heartbeat",
  color = "orange"
)
```
